competition_formats.notes: Sixteen clubs play a double round robin (30 games each). Ranks 1-6 qualify directly for the playoffs. Ranks 7-10 enter a three-game Play-In that awards seeds 7 and 8. The 7/8 winner becomes seed 7; the loser hosts the 9/10 winner for seed 8. Quarterfinals are best-of-three; semifinals and final are best-of-five. The better regular-season seed has home-court advantage. Rank 16 is directly relegated to ELITE 2. Rank 15 is retained as a documented ELITE 2 access-playoff consequence in the source notes until ELITE 2 gets its own B03 target competition.

competition_formats.notes: The men's Coupe de France Robert Busnel uses staggered entry across the professional and national divisions. Round 1 starts with 46 teams: 19 ELITE 2, 26 NM1 and the 2025 Trophée masculin winner from NM2. Eight Betclic ELITE clubs enter Round 2. Later European Betclic ELITE clubs enter for the round of 16. Early draws use geographical organization; the round of 16 and quarterfinal draw are integral. The lower-level club hosts, or if levels are equal the first club drawn hosts. A lower-level club starts with seven points per division of difference. Quarterfinal draw also fixes semifinal bracket paths. The final is a single game at Accor Arena.

competition_formats.notes: Canonical pre-season competition structure for Serie A Unipol 2025-26. The season starts with 16 teams, an asymmetric-order home-and-away regular season, Top 8 playoffs and two annual relegation slots. The playoff bracket is explicit from quarterfinal seeds through semifinal paths and final. Trapani Shark's in-season exclusion and the annulment of its played games are deliberately not baked into the static format: an excluded club counts among relegated clubs under the FIP DOA, and FIP consequently reduced the remaining sporting relegations to one. That is a mutable competition event/runtime concern, not a different league format.

competition_formats.notes: All 30 NBA teams enter Group Play. Within each conference, teams are placed into five pots from 2024-25 regular-season record and drawn into three temporary groups of five, one team from each pot per group. Each team plays four group games, two home and two away. Six group winners plus the best second-place team in each conference advance. Group Play, Quarterfinals and Semifinals are also NBA regular-season games and must share the same physical B12 match through game_fixture_realization; the Championship is Cup-only. Quarterfinals are in team markets, while the 2025 Semifinals and Championship are neutral-site games at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.

The NIT remains a 32-team NCAA-managed postseason tournament. NCAA's current selection procedure uses a committee to select the 32-team field, seed the top 16 and place teams into the bracket. Detailed 2027 event-specific selection amendments and final-site details were not yet separately published when this Phase 1 pack was certified, so the structural bracket uses the latest official NCAA NIT format: 32-team single elimination, first round, second round and quarterfinals before neutral-site semifinals and final. Selection policy is deliberately represented as committee-driven rather than hard-coding an obsolete conference-exempt-bid formula.
